# AI Swiss Knife — Full Machine-Readable Index (v2.1.0)

## Chapter 01 · Zero-Card Cloud APIs, Decisions & Grounding
Verdict: Only 6 cloud gateways remain genuinely card-free as of Nov 2026—pair Google AI Studio (Gemini 4 Hydrogen / 3.8 Flash) and Z.ai (GLM-4.7-Flash) for agent loops, Cloudflare/Google for $0-output System-1 decisions, and keyless Jina/Firecrawl/Exa for RAG.

### 1. Task-Routed Cloud Intelligence & Decision Matrix
- **Autonomous Coding & Everyday**<br><sub>Multi-file edits, Bash, MCP loops</sub> | **`Gemini 4 Hydrogen` / `3.8 Flash`**<br><sub>🏆 Nov 2026 fast successor (Everyday & Thinking · 1M ctx)</sub><br>**`GLM-4.7-Flash`** · `MIT`<br><sub>🏆 **79.5** τ²-Bench · 200K ctx / 128K out</sub> | [**Google AI Studio**](https://aistudio.google.com/)<br><sub><kbd>No Card</kbd> Free per-project + App Free/Plus/Pro/Ultra</sub><br>[**Z.ai BigModel**](https://open.bigmodel.cn/)<br><sub><kbd>No Card</kbd> Completely Free Flash tier</sub> | ⚠️ **Z.ai Fix:** Only `glm-4.7-flash` is permanently free (`glm-5.x` is billed).<br>💡 **Cheap Cloud:** `Inkling 2 Mini` on OpenRouter (`io.net`) is **$0.08/M in, $0.35/M out**.
- **Frontier Heavyweights (500B+)**<br><sub>MoE VLM & PhD reasoning</sub> | **`DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash`** · `552B`<br><sub>🏆 Frontier open VLM/coder (8B active)</sub><br>**`Nemotron-3.5-Super-VL`** · `120B`<br><sub>🏆 & `Inkling 2 Small` / `Kimi` via `:free`</sub> | [**NVIDIA NIM**](https://build.nvidia.com/)<br><sub><kbd>No Card</kbd> ~40 RPM Dev Catalog</sub><br>[**OpenRouter `:free`**](https://openrouter.ai/)<br><sub><kbd>10 Cr</kbd> Unlocks **1,000 RPD** (vs 50)</sub> | ⚠️ **NIM** is prototyping-only with occasional MoE cold-start queues.<br>⚠️ **OpenRouter** returns `402` even on `:free` if balance goes negative.
- **System-1 Decision & Extract**<br><sub>Single-pass probabilities ($0 out)</sub> | **`Gemini Decision 1`**<br><sub>🏆 Up to **1,000** typed questions/pass (multimodal)</sub><br>**`Clairic` / `Clef` / `Clef-Omni`**<br><sub>🏆 Zero-output extraction, 64-step forecasts, audio/video</sub> | [**Google AI Studio**](https://aistudio.google.com/)<br><sub><kbd>No Card</kbd> **200 RPM · 50K TPM · 10K RPD**</sub><br>[**Cloudflare Workers AI**](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/)<br><sub><kbd>No Card</kbd> **10,000 Neurons/day** free</sub> | ✅ **Zero Output Tokens Billed:** Ideal for agent safety gates, routing, and structured span extraction.<br>⚠️ Cloudflare retired legacy models Nov 20, 2026 (`HTTP 410`).
- **Fast Micro-Routers (<6K)**<br><sub>Sub-second JSON & small prompts</sub> | **`qwen/qwen3.8-27b`**<br><sub>🏆 Verified active on Groq free LPU</sub><br>**`gpt-oss-120b` / `gpt-oss-20b`**<br><sub>🏆 Ultra-fast structured transforms</sub> | [**Groq Cloud**](https://console.groq.com/)<br><sub><kbd>No Card</kbd> **30 RPM · 1K RPD · 200K TPD**</sub><br>[**Google AI Studio**](https://aistudio.google.com/)<br><sub><kbd>No Card</kbd> `4 Hydrogen` / `3.5 Flash-Lite`</sub> | ⚠️ **Groq 8K TPM Wall:** Strictly for <6K token prompts (429s on coding agents). Llama 3.1/3.3 moved to Contact Sales.

### 2. Grounding, Search, Scraping & RAG Stack (100% Card-Free)
- **Keyless Web Scraper**<br><sub>Clean Markdown for LLM context</sub> | [**Firecrawl (`Keyless` & API)**](https://www.firecrawl.dev/)<br><sub>🏆 Lowest token bloat (**7,456** med. tok/task)</sub> | <kbd>Keyless</kbd> Official agent onboarding skill<br><sub>+ **500 credits** on signup</sub> | ✅ Ships `agent-onboarding/SKILL.md` for zero-key foraging.<br>⚠️ Keyless mode is IP-rate-limited; pass API key for burst jobs.
- **Zero-SDK URL / PDF Reader**<br><sub>Instant prefix conversion</sub> | [**Jina Reader (`r.jina.ai`)**](https://jina.ai/reader/)<br><sub>🏆 Zero-install URL-to-Markdown</sub> | <kbd>Keyless</kbd> Free rate-limited prefix<br><sub>+ **10,000,000 free tokens** w/ API key</sub> | ✅ Prepend `https://r.jina.ai/` to any URL/PDF or `https://s.jina.ai/?q=` for keyless search.
- **Neural & Deep Agent Search**<br><sub>Semantic web retrieval</sub> | [**Exa 3.0 (`Lite` / `Deep`)**](https://exa.ai/)<br><sub>🏆 Built natively for autonomous agents</sub> | <kbd>No Card</kbd> **$10/mo recurring credits**<br><sub>+ $10 bonus (**10 QPS** search / **100 QPS** contents)</sub> | ✅ Resets 1st of every month (~2,500 Lite searches) + supports **50 concurrent agent runs**.
- **Pre-Chunked RAG Search**<br><sub>Factual snippet injection</sub> | [**Tavily Search API**](https://tavily.com/)<br><sub>🏆 Skips custom HTML chunking pipelines</sub> | <kbd>No Card</kbd> **1,000 credits/mo forever**<br><sub>+ Keyless mode for Hermes Agent</sub> | ✅ Pre-scored context chunks ready for prompt injection.<br>⚠️ `advanced` depth costs 2 credits vs 1 for `basic`.
- **Embeddings & Reranking**<br><sub>Two-stage vector + probability filter</sub> | [**Cohere `Embed 5` & `Rerank 5`**](https://cohere.com/)<br><sub>🏆 Shared `Pro`/`Fast` embedding space</sub> | <kbd>No Card</kbd> **1,000 calls/mo** (Trial Key)<br><sub>10 Rerank/min · 20 Chat/min</sub> | ✅ Index w/ `Embed 5 Pro`, query w/ `Fast` (98.4% retention), rerank via `Rerank 5` (32K ctx, JSON/YAML).
- **Academic & Paper Graph**<br><sub>Citations, abstracts, open PDFs</sub> | [**OpenAlex**](https://openalex.org/) + [**arXiv API**](https://arxiv.org/help/api/)<br><sub>🏆 250M+ scholarly works & citations</sub> | <kbd>Keyless</kbd> **100,000 requests/day**<br><sub>100% free forever</sub> | ✅ Pass `?mailto=you@domain.com` in OpenAlex URLs to enter the fast polite pool with zero auth keys.

## Chapter 02 · Local AI Models (16GB VRAM + 64GB RAM)
Verdict: Separate your local stack into two tracks: Mature & Fully Riced daily drivers (Qwen3.8-27B + Harness Adapters, Qwen3-Coder-Next, Gemma 4) vs. Cutting-Edge experimental architectures (Inkling 2 Mini looped MoE, varloop, DiffusionGemma, Muse Glimmer) that require newer runtimes and stricter turn caps.

### 1. Track A · Mature & Fully Riced (Battle-Tested Daily Drivers)
- **Riced 27B + Harness LoRAs**<br><sub>Zone 1 · 100% in 16GB VRAM</sub> | **`Qwen3.8-27B`** (Base Vision+Text)<br>+ **`Qwen3.8-27B-{pi|hermes|opencode}-adapted`**<br>+ **`Qwen3.8-27B-super-adapter`** (`rank-96`) | `CN/HF` · `Apache-2.0`<br><sub><kbd>14–15 GB</kbd> (`IQ4_XS`) + <kbd>304–912 MiB</kbd> LoRA (`--lora`) or Mac `MLX-6bit`</sub> | 🏆 **Thinking Off (`pi`):** **39.2%→64.7%** SWE-Pro hard-51 (**56–72%** fewer tool calls). **Thinking On (`super`):** **55.5%→63.5%** mean pass@1.<br>⚠️ Adapters were RL-trained on BF16; verify quant fidelity (`Q8_0`/`IQ4_XS`) and expect mild pre-tool reasoning leakage (`arXiv:2610.14270`).
- **Mature Hybrid MoE Coders**<br><sub>Zone 2 · 19–49 GB Sparse MoE</sub> | **`Qwen3-Coder-Next (80B-A3B)`** (~49 GB)<br>**`North-Mini-Code-1.0 (30B-A3B)`** (~19 GB)<br>**`Nemotron-Cascade-2 (30B-A3B)`** (90.9% AIME) | `CN/CA/US` · `Apache-2.0` / `NVIDIA Open`<br><sub><kbd>19–49 GB</kbd> (`UD-Q4_K_XL`) · 3B active</sub> | 🏆 Standard `llama.cpp` / `ik_llama.cpp` support with predictable `--n-cpu-moe` sweeps and zero custom kernel breakage.<br>⚠️ Always keep `-ngl 99` so Attention + KV stay on GPU.
- **Fast General, Vision & Audio**<br><sub>Zone 1 · 8–15 GB VRAM</sub> | **`Gemma 4 (26B-A4B)`** · `Text+Vision Only`<br><sub>**3.8B active** · ~140 tok/s in 16GB VRAM</sub><br>**`Gemma 4 (12B)`** (Audio+Vis) · **`Devstral Small 2`** | `US/EU` · `Apache-2.0`<br><sub><kbd>8–15 GB</kbd> (`Q4_K_M` / `IQ4_XS`)</sub> | ✅ Zero-drama daily generalists across `llama.cpp`, `vLLM`, and `MLX`.<br>⚠️ **Gemma 4 Audio Trap:** Only `E2B`/`E4B`/`12B` process audio—`26B-A4B` is **Text + Vision only**.

### 2. Track B · Cutting-Edge Local (Experimental Architectures & High Upside)
- **Looped Transformer MoEs**<br><sub>Zone 1 (`Q3`) & Zone 2 (`Q4`/`NVFP4`)</sub> | **`Inkling 2 Mini`** (**26.4B** / **3.4B** base / **5.4B** eff.)<br><sub>Middle 12 layers looped 3× + `DSpark` drafter · 1M ctx</sub><br>**`TML-d24-varloop-research`** (variable loops) | `US` · `Apache-2.0` + AUP<br><sub><kbd>7.76–22.87 GB</kbd> (`UD-Q4_K_XL` **17.6 GB** + `639 MB` vision)</sub> | 🏆 **79.2%** SWE-bench Verified, **48.2%** DeepSWE v1.1, **0.703** IPW (*lab-reported*). Runs up to **60 tok/s** on 16GB RTX 5060 Ti via `Basalt`.<br>⚠️ Needs Unsloth/Basalt runtime; can loop while debugging (cap turns/tokens); weaker factual recall & non-English; sandbox file ops.
- **180B N-Gram Prefetch Ceiling**<br><sub>Zone 2 Ceiling · 66–73 GB Total</sub> | **`Qwen3.8-Flash-Next`**<br><sub>**180B** (125B MoE + 51B N-gram + 4B MTP) / **6B active**</sub><br><sub>Unsloth Dynamic v3.1 (`UD-IQ1_S` / `IQ1_M` / `Q2_0`)</sub> | `CN` · `qwen-community-1.0`<br><sub><kbd>66.4–70.5 GB</kbd> + **1.9–2.8 GB** MTP (9–13 GB OS margin)</sub> | 🏆 **91.9** DeepSWE 1.1; 51B N-gram table prefetches asynchronously from 64GB DDR5 at near-GPU speed.<br>⚠️ **Hard Cap:** Never load `UD-Q2_K_XL` (79.6 GB) on 16+64 GB—leaves 0 GB for OS/KV.
- **Block-Diffusion & Native 2-Bit**<br><sub>Zone 2 · 18–25 GB</sub> | **`Meta Muse Glimmer (30B + DFlash)`** (~20 GB)<br>**`DiffusionGemma (26B-A4B)`** (256-tok parallel)<br>**`Recursive Flint (39.8B-A2.5B)`** · **`Nemotron Bolt 74B`** | `US` · `Apache-2.0` / `OpenMDW`<br><sub><kbd>18–25 GB</kbd> (`DFlash` 16-tok drafter / 2-bit QAT)</sub> | 🏆 `Muse Glimmer` (**94.7%** AIME) drafts 16 tokens/pass; `DiffusionGemma` denoises parallel blocks.<br>⚠️ `Flint` scores (**89.7%** SWE-Pro v2) are *vendor-reported* and trail `Qwen3.8-27B` on Unsloth evals.

### 3. System-1 Local Decision Models (Non-Autoregressive)
- **Zero-Token Agent Gates**<br><sub>Tool safety, trace audit, memory</sub> | **`Laya`** (`convaiinnovations/laya`)<br><sub>• `laya-typed-decisions` (**846 MB**)<br>• `laya-multilingual` (**678 MB**, 100+ langs)</sub> | <kbd>678–846 MB</kbd> (CPU/NPU/WebGPU)<br><sub>⚡ **<100–500ms** · 64 questions/pass</sub> | 🔌 Serve via **Unsloth Decision API** (`localhost:8888`, `typesafe-sdk`) or `laya.cpp`.<br>⚠️ Threshold on `probabilities` (not `confidence`); review borderline *superseded vs contradicted* cases.
- **Custom 16K Clef-Head**<br><sub>Domain-tuned local classifier</sub> | **`Qwen3.5-4B` / `Qwen3.8` / `Gemma 4`**<br><sub>+ `Clef Head` via `Unsloth DecisionTrainer`</sub> | <kbd>3–15 GB VRAM</kbd><br><sub>⚡ Single pass up to **16,384 tok**</sub> | 🏆 1-epoch 4-bit LoRA (`r=16`/`64`) lifts routing accuracy from ~35% zero-shot to **78%–81%** with zero output tokens generated.

## Chapter 03 · Multimodal, Voice, Video & World Models
Verdict: Use zero-card cloud APIs for fast audio STT (Groq Whisper), multi-PDF vision (Gemini 3.8 Flash), and keyless FLUX drafts— but pivot immediately to local open weights for RGBA editing, directed multi-speaker TTS, interactive world models, and 1080p video.

### 1. Unified Cloud-Free vs. Local Pivot Matrix
- **Image Gen & Native RGBA**<br><sub>2048px typography & 10-ref lock</sub> | **`Qwen-Image-2.1` (7B DiT)**<br><sub>#1 VDEBench · Native RGBA layers</sub><br>**`FLUX.2 Klein`** · **`FLUX.1 Kontext`**<br>**`SenseNova-U1.5 (8B)`** (4K infographics) | ☁️ [**Pollinations**](https://pollinations.ai/) (<kbd>Keyless</kbd> FLUX)<br>🖥️ <kbd>8–14 GB VRAM</kbd> (`2.1` = **9.1 GB** Q4) | ✅ Separate `Qwen-Image-2.1` (7B, fits 16GB easily) from `nvidia/Qwen-Image-Flash` (20.4B DiT, needs RAM offload).<br>⚠️ `2.1` is `Qwen Research` (non-commercial); use **`FLUX.2 Klein` (`Apache-2.0`)** commercially.
- **Video + Audio & World Models**<br><sub>1080p video & WASD walkable worlds</sub> | **`Wan 2.2 (5B & A14B)`** · `Apache-2.0`<br>**`LTX-2.5 (22B Video+Audio)`** · `Kandinsky 6.0 Lite`<br>**`Tencent Hy-Nomas`** (Interactive World Model) | ☁️ **No Permanent Free Cloud Video**<br><sub>(MiniMax $5 trial only)</sub><br>🖥️ <kbd>5.9–15 GB VRAM</kbd> + 64GB RAM swap | 🏆 **`WanGP v20.12`** Extreme Chunker runs 15s 1080p `Hailuo H3` in **5.9 GB VRAM**.<br>🏆 **`Hy-Nomas`** generates WASD-walkable worlds on 1 GPU (pair w/ `LTX-2.5` for audio).
- **Directed Voice, TTS & Duplex**<br><sub>16-speaker acting & 4.9ms WebGPU</sub> | **`Fish Audio Drama 3 (35B-A3B)`** (1245 Elo)<br>**`Ming-3.0-tts`** & **`ZONOS3 Mini`** (43 langs)<br>**`Phonon 31M`** (64.5 MB) · **`Kyutai Moshi`** | ☁️ [**Fish Audio**](https://fish.audio/) (<kbd>No Card</kbd> Fair-Use)<br>🖥️ <kbd>0.06–20 GB</kbd> (`Drama 3` in Zone 2) | 🏆 **`Phonon 31M`** (`Apache-2.0`, English-only; `40M` is `CC BY-NC`) runs in browser WebGPU at **115×–130× RT (4.9ms)**.<br>🏆 **`Drama 3`** (`Fish Community <$500K`) supports 16 speakers + word inpainting via `SGLang-Omni`.
- **Speech-to-Text & Alignment**<br><sub>Real-time ASR + word timestamps</sub> | **`Whisper-Large-v3-Turbo`** (`MIT`)<br>**`Qwen3-ASR (1.7B)` + `ForcedAligner-0.6B`**<br>**`Deepgram Nova-3`** (Streaming) | ☁️ [**Groq**](https://console.groq.com/) (**2K RPD / 28.8K s/day**)<br>🖥️ <kbd>2–3 GB VRAM</kbd> (10× real-time) | 🏆 `Qwen3-ASR` + `ForcedAligner` delivers single-pass word timestamps locally.<br>⚠️ Chunk audio files >25 MB before calling Groq.
- **Causal OCR, GUI & Visual RAG**<br><sub>PDF reading order & zero-VRAM RAG</sub> | **OCR:** **`DeepSeek-OCR 2 (3B)`** · `olmOCR-2`<br>**GUI:** **`UI-TARS (7B)`** · `North Micro Vision`<br>**RAG:** **`EmbeddingGemma 2`** · **`Qwen3-VL-Embed`** | ☁️ **Gemini 3.8 Vision** / **NIM VLM**<br>🖥️ <kbd>1.5–10 GB</kbd> (Run RAG on CPU RAM) | ✅ `DeepSeek-OCR 2` uses Visual Causal Flow for multi-column tables (<4 GB VRAM). Pin `EmbeddingGemma 2` in 64GB RAM so RAG uses **0 MB VRAM**.

## Chapter 04 · Agent Harnesses, Protocols & Safety
Verdict: Organize harnesses by architectural role: treat Pi / Pi Durable as your minimal building-block kernel, DeepSeek Harness (dsh) as the Cordis plugin-everything platform, and Hermes Agent as the self-improving autonomous daemon—all shielded by safeagents.

### 1. Agent Harnesses by Architectural Role
- **🧱 Building-Block Kernel**<br>**`Pi` (`pi.dev`) + `Pi Durable`**<br><sub>MIT · TUI / RPC / SDK</sub> | Minimal hackable loop you own +<br><sub>SQLite crash-resumable state</sub> | Transparent context assembly, built-in **`MCP + Codemode`** (JS sandbox), `/tree` DAG session branching, atomic shared JSON app state, background compaction (200K/250K), live mid-run tool hot-swap. | 🏆 Highest-scoring target for HF `Qwen3.8-27B-pi-adapted` (**64.7%** SWE-Pro hard-51) & `Inkling 2 Mini`.<br>⚠️ Intentionally omits built-in approval gates—pair w/ `safeagents` or sandboxes.
- **🧩 Plugin-Everything Platform**<br>**`DeepSeek Harness` (`dsh`)**<br><sub>MIT · 287K+ ★ · `deepseek-ai`</sub> | **Cordis** (*Everything is a Plugin*)<br><sub>Web (`npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`) & Desktop</sub> | Lets you **swap the agent loop itself** as a plugin, **Creator Mode** (author live plugins in chat), read-only-by-default **built-in sandbox**, trace inspector, cron tasks, & first-party plugins driving **Claude Code / Codex** as sub-agents. | ✅ Supports DeepSeek, Anthropic, OpenAI, Moonshot, Z.ai, & local OpenAI-compat servers.<br>⚠️ Fast-moving developer preview (`0.2.3-alpha.2`)—pin plugin versions.
- **🌱 Self-Improving Daemon**<br>**`Hermes Agent` (`v0.23.4`)**<br><sub>MIT · 266K+ ★ · `NousResearch`</sub> | Persistent learning loop +<br><sub>Multi-surface (Desktop/VPS/Telegram)</sub> | #1 globally on OpenRouter token volume; persistent memory + **autonomous skill creation**, 40+ tools, ACP support, cron scheduler, isolated subagents, & disk archival of pruned tool outputs. | 🏆 Official HF Harness Adapter target (`Qwen3.8-27B-hermes-adapted` & `LFM2.5-24B`).<br>⚠️ Does not auto-compact aggressively like `Pi`—cap context/thinking tokens on giant repos.
- **🖥️ IDE & Vendor Harnesses**<br>**`Google Antigravity` · `Zed ACP` · `OpenCode`** | Native multi-file review UI +<br><sub>Agent Client Protocol (`Apache-2.0`)</sub> | **Antigravity:** Live w/ **`Gemini 4 Hydrogen`** (Everyday/Thinking + Task mode), `3.8 Flash`, & `4 Argon/Carbon/Neon`. **Zed ACP Registry:** Unifies `Pi`, `Claude`, `Codex`, `Gemini`, & `OpenCode` w/ zero server telemetry. | ✅ Wire `Claude Code` or `OpenCode` to local `Qwen3.8-27B-super-adapter` via Unsloth's Anthropic/OpenAI endpoints.

### 2. Protocols, Skills, Context & Runtime Safety
- **`safeagents` Proxy & Plugins**<br><sub>`huggingface/safeagents`</sub> | Transparent OpenAI/Anthropic proxy<br><sub>Works w/ Pi, Hermes, OpenCode, Claude</sub> | 3-stage guard: request checks, `atif-scan` (10–20ms on Apple Silicon), + optional **Decision Model judge**; Hub plugins (`hf://harness-hub/qwen-safeagents-plugin`). | 🏆 Audited **1.3M** RL tool calls & blocked **647** suspicious calls during HF harness-adapter training.
- **Progressive Skills (`SKILL.md`)**<br><sub>vs. Bloated MCP Tool Lists</sub> | `skills/<name>/SKILL.md` +<br><sub>`obra/superpowers` · `Deepy Skills`</sub> | Loads instructions & scripts **on demand** instead of stuffing 30+ MCP schemas into the system prompt (which destroys KV prompt caching). | ✅ Use `Pi` **MCP + Codemode** when you need complex multi-tool orchestration in a JS sandbox.
- **Layered Context & Archival**<br><sub>vs. Lossy Rolling Summaries</sub> | `AGENTS.md` · `llms.txt`<br><sub>Unsloth Archival · `Durable Pi`</sub> | Gives deterministic repo invariants in <500 tokens and archives old turns to searchable SQLite/vector history at 200K tokens rather than destructive summarization. | ✅ Pair with `Laya` + `all-MiniLM-L6-v2` (23 MB) for auditable memory invalidation ledgers.

## Chapter 05 · Backends, Quantization & 2026 Flag Bible
Verdict: Serving kernels and memory flags matter as much as model weights: `--n-cpu-moe` unlocks 64GB RAM MoEs without touching `-ngl`, Unsloth accelerates looped & VRAM-exceeding GGUFs 1.9×–3×, and `WanGP v20.12` squeezes 1080p video into 5.9 GB VRAM.

### 1. Inference Studios, Engines & Low-VRAM Media Backends
- **Unsloth Runtime & Studio**<br><sub>`v0.1.923-beta` (Tauri + CLI)</sub> | Local LLMs, Decisions, & RL/LoRA<br><sub>OpenAI + Anthropic API server</sub> | **1.9×** faster `Inkling 2 Mini`, **3×** faster VRAM-exceeding MoE GGUFs, **4.1×** faster `Laya`, `AsyncGRPO`, retrieval Context Archival, AMD NPU, & `FastWan`. | ✅ **Mandatory** for `Inkling 2 Mini` looped-layer GGUFs and self-healing JSON/XML tool calls.
- **`llama.cpp` vs `ik_llama.cpp`**<br><sub>Mainline vs. SOTA Perf Fork</sub> | GGUF CPU + GPU hybrid inference<br><sub>CUDA, Metal, Vulkan, ROCm</sub> | `ik_llama.cpp` leads bleeding-edge kernels: **FlashMLA**, **IQK AVX-512 (`HAVE_FANCY_SIMD`)**, Trellis quants (`IQ2_KS`/`IQ3_KT`), dynamic MoE caching. | ⚠️ `ik_llama.cpp` is **CPU + NVIDIA CUDA only**; avoid `-rtr` on k-quants w/ MoE offload & avoid raw `f16` `_XL` tensors.
- **`WanGP v20.12` + `MMGP v4`**<br><sub>`deepbeepmeep/WanGP`</sub> | Low-VRAM Video, Image & Avatars<br><sub>`Wan 2.2`, `H3`, `LTX-2.5`, `SenseNova`</sub> | **Extreme Chunker** (**5.9 GB VRAM** for 15s 1080p H3), **`pi-H3` DWD** (2–4 steps), **Infinite Sliding Windows**, **`SageGP 1.0.2`**, `Deepy Prime` MCP + `Deepy Apps`. | ✅ Install `WGPKernels 1.5.0` & `SageGP 1.0.2` (PyTorch 2.10; Triton 3.6+ for RTX 50xx adaptive Sage2/3).
- **`ComfyUI v0.46` & `SGLang-Omni`**<br><sub>Node graphs & multimodal serving</sub> | Custom media pipelines & TTS<br><sub>`Fish Drama 3`, `Qwen-Image-2.1`</sub> | `ComfyUI v0.46`: `SenseNova`, `RMBG 3.0`, RAFT `Video Deflicker`, `KJNodes` block-swap; `SGLang-Omni` serves `Fish Audio Drama 3`. | 💡 Use `stable-diffusion.cpp` for lightweight CLI `Qwen-Image-2.1` (`Q4_K_M`, 9.1 GB VRAM).

### 2. Acceleration, Quantization & The 2026 Flag Bible
- **The `--n-cpu-moe` Sweep**<br><sub>Zone 2 Hybrid MoE Law</sub> | `-ngl 99 -fa on --n-cpu-moe N` | Pins **100% of Attention + KV cache** on your 16GB GPU while pushing only sparse FFN experts of the first `N` layers to 64GB DDR5 RAM. | ⚠️ **Never lower `-ngl` on MoEs.** Sweep `N` down by 2 until VRAM spills, then step up by 1–2.
- **Unified Load Mode**<br><sub>Replaces `--no-mmap` / `--mlock`</sub> | `--load-mode none` or `mlock`<br><sub>Env: `LLAMA_ARG_LOAD_MODE`</sub> | Replaces deprecated `--no-mmap` / `--mlock` flags in modern `llama.cpp` to prevent OS page-cache thrashing on 64GB RAM loads. | ⚠️ If partial MoE offload + CUDA graphs outputs gibberish, add **`-cuda graphs=0`**.
- **KV Cache Quantization**<br><sub>Memory-fitting vs. Speed</sub> | `-ctk q8_0 -ctv q8_0`<br><sub>Requires `-fa on` (Flash Attn)</sub> | Halves KV cache VRAM so 24B–27B dense models (`Qwen3.8-27B`) and 120K MoE contexts fit cleanly inside 16GB VRAM. | ⚠️ **Not a speed boost:** Keep `f16` KV cache whenever it fits in VRAM; use `q8_0` only to prevent RAM spill.
- **Next-Gen Multi-Token Tech**<br><sub>`DFlash` · `DSpark` · `MTP` · `N-gram`</sub> | `--spec-draft-n-max 2` (Inkling)<br><sub>`Dynamic v3.1` (`UD-*`) quants</sub> | `DFlash` drafts **16 tokens/pass** (`Muse Glimmer`/`Bolt`); `DSpark` (1 GB) accelerates `Inkling 2 Mini`; `N-gram` prefetches 51B tables from RAM (`Qwen3.8-Flash`). | ⚠️ On `Inkling 2 Mini`, raising `--spec-draft-n-max` above 2 can degrade looped-layer acceptance.

### 3. OS, Sandboxing & Silicon-Exclusive Stacks
- **Linux (First-Class Host)**<br><sub>CUDA · ROCm · Zen 4/5 AVX-512</sub> | `Bwrap` Sandbox · `ik_llama.cpp`<br><sub>Kernel Hugepages · `HAVE_FANCY_SIMD`</sub> | Fastest 64GB DDR5 MoE streaming (AVX-512 IQK kernels) + Unsloth OS-enforced **`Bwrap`** bash/python sandboxing. | ✅ Preferred host OS for 16GB NVIDIA + 64GB DDR5 hybrid MoE workstations.
- **NVIDIA Ada / Blackwell**<br><sub>RTX 40xx / 50xx & DGX Spark</sub> | `NVFP4` · `SageGP 1.0.2`<br><sub>`FlashMLA` · CUDA Graphs</sub> | RTX 50xx gets native `NVFP4` + adaptive `Sage2/3 GP` precision; RTX 20xx–40xx gain `SageGP` Extreme Chunker kernels for `WanGP`. | ⚠️ Update to PyTorch 2.10 + Triton 3.6+ for Blackwell `sage3 gp` adaptive modes.
- **macOS (Apple Silicon / Mac mini)**<br><sub>Unified Memory + `Seatbelt`</sub> | `MLX` (`mlx-lm` / `mlx-vlm`)<br><sub>Unsloth Mac **2.8×** Speculative</sub> | Zero PCIe copy bottleneck up to unified RAM ceiling + macOS **`Seatbelt`** sandbox; runs `Qwen3.8-27B-super-adapter-MLX` at ~65 tok/s (4-bit). | ⚠️ Prompt prefill lags dedicated NVIDIA Tensor Cores; 32GB+ unified RAM recommended for 27B MLX.
- **AMD NPU, Windows & WebGPU**<br><sub>Tri-Hybrid & Zero-Server Browser</sub> | Unsloth AMD NPU · Win **`MXC`**<br><sub>WebGPU (`Phonon 31M` / `Laya`)</sub> | Run `Laya` decisions on AMD NPU/CPU or `Phonon 31M` TTS at **130× RT (4.9ms)** directly in browser WebGPU while GPU stays 100% free. | ✅ Windows users get native **`MXC`** sandboxing in Unsloth Studio and Redtash1 one-click `WanGP` builds.

## Chapter 06 · Harness Adapters, In-Harness RL & Frontier Research
Verdict: Instead of chasing giant base models, freeze one strong 27B backbone and train lightweight RL LoRA adapters directly inside your unmodified shipping harness— cutting tool calls by 53–73% while gaining +13 to +25 points, and merging orthogonal adapters at rank 96 with zero retraining.

### 1. Harness Adapters Architecture & Full Hugging Face RL Recipe
- **In-Harness Proxy RL**<br><sub>No re-implemented agent loops</sub> | [HF Harness Adapters](https://huggingface.co/blog/harness-adapters-at-scale)<br><sub>`OpenEnv` · `Harbor` · `TRL AsyncGRPO` · `Agent Lightning` (`2608.17528`)</sub> | Token/logprob capture proxy sits between unmodified `Pi 1.5.2` / `OpenCode 2.2.7` / `Hermes v0.22.6` and vLLM (2×B200; 598 steps / 167M tokens). `pi` lifts SWE-Pro hard-51 **39.2%→64.7%** (**56–72%** fewer calls). | ⚠️ Use `all-linear` LoRA, LR **`2e-5`** (`1e-4` collapses rollouts), tool bonus `0.1`, repo-family interleaving, & maxed `--token-budget` (**1.2×–2.3×** groups/step).
- **Data Validation & Difficulty Gate**<br><sub>Quality beats raw task volume</sub> | `harness-hub/agentic-coding-envs`<br><sub>`SWE-smith` (717) · `TaskTrove` (130) · `Tasksmith`/`Repo2RLEnv` (24) + `termgrade` (300)</sub> | `openenv validate` (`oracle_max`, `floor_gap`, `canary_floor`, `episode_determinism`) passed **858/1,127** tasks; difficulty check kept **171/442** (*solved sometimes*), lifting step-50 reward to **0.81** vs **0.63**. | ✅ Caught broken verifiers including `regex-log` on TB2.1. Never train GRPO on all-pass or all-fail tasks (zero advantage signal).
- **Specialist vs. Rank-96 Super-Adapter**<br><sub>Orthogonal LoRA merging</sub> | `harness-hub/Qwen3.8-27B-super-adapter`<br><sub>`PEFT cat` (`3×32=96`) · `2212.04089` · `2306.01708` · `2410.19735`</sub> | Adapters have `~0.01–0.02` cosine similarity. Merging at weight **`½`** beats base on **6/6** pairs thinking off (**39.5%→49.0%**) and **5/6** thinking on (**55.5%→63.5%**, **31–48%** fewer SWE-Pro calls). | ✅ **Rule:** Single harness + thinking off → **Specialist** (`pi` **64.0%** vs **46.0%**). Thinking on (`xhigh`) or multi-harness fleet → **Super-Adapter**.
- **Transfer, Leakage & Safety**<br><sub>Cross-harness + `safeagents`</sub> | `arXiv:2610.14270` (Thinking Leakage)<br>`harness-hub/qwen-safeagents-plugin` | `pi` LoRA transfers to OpenCode (**44.8%→54.0%**) & Hermes (**46.3%→56.1%**); community confirmed transfer to `Swift-1.5` & proposed **MOPD**. `safeagents` checked **1.3M** calls & blocked **647**. | ⚠️ Non-thinking RL induces short pre-tool *thinking leakage* (net-positive under fixed budgets); OOD `AutomationBench` stays near base noise (`23.7%` vs `23.0%`).

### 2. Frontier Self-Improvement & Test-Time Compute Leads
- **Gradient-Free Self-Rewriting**<br><sub>Weight Editing via Reasoning</sub> | UIUC (`arXiv:2611.21885`)<br><sub>Nov 16–20, 2026</sub> | Demonstrates an LLM diagnosing failures via pure reasoning and rewriting its own weights across sessions with **zero gradients or training runs**. | 🔬 Watch for persistent local agents that permanently patch recurring coding mistakes without RL clusters.
- **Variable-Loop Test-Time Compute**<br><sub>Dynamic Layer Depth per Token</sub> | `thinkingmachines/TML-d24-varloop-research` | Companion to `Inkling 2 Mini` allowing inference-time `loop_num_passes` control—trading latency for depth without swapping checkpoints. | 🧪 Pair with a `Laya` System-1 router: 1 loop for trivial edits, 3+ loops for hard bugs.
- **Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation**<br><sub>Community MOPD Proposal</sub> | `harness-hub` Community Discussions | Distill per-harness RL LoRAs (`pi`, `hermes`, `opencode`, `dsh`) as teachers back into a single student base (`Qwen3.8-27B`) to avoid rank-96 merge dilution. | 🧪 Next evolutionary step beyond `PEFT cat` once a `DeepSeek Harness` adapter joins the pool.

## Chapter 07 · Community Field Notes (IRL Builds & Workflows)
Verdict: The biggest real-world gains rarely come from raw model drops alone—they come from community alt-engines (3×–6× faster on 12–16GB GPUs), discipline skill packs (obra/superpowers), two-pass audit loops, and multi-tool indie pipelines chained together on consumer hardware.

### 1. Underground 12–16GB Engine Hacks & Audit Loops
- **`Basalt` (`0.5.5+`) & `RustingStrata`**<br><sub>Alt-engines for `Inkling 2 Mini`</sub> | RTX 3060 12GB · RTX 5060 Ti 16GB<br><sub>NVFP4 + `DSpark` native kernels</sub> | `Basalt` hits **up to 60 tok/s on a 16GB RTX 5060 Ti** (spilling cold experts to RAM only on long chats) & **613 tok/s** on 5090. `RustingStrata` hits **31 tok/s on RTX 3060 12GB** (vs 9–10 tok/s stock `llama.cpp`). | 🔥 Proves community engines already unlock 3×–6× speedups on looped MoEs.<br>⚠️ Rapidly evolving single-GPU engines—pin working git commits.
- **`pecera-engine` + Hermes Self-Check**<br><sub>r/LocalLLaMA indie build (Nov 2026)</sub> | Single 12GB RTX 4070 Ti +<br><sub>`Inkling 2 Mini` (`mixC` 10.8 GiB) + Hermes</sub> | Rebased `realugbun` fused CUDA glue-op kernels onto `llama.cpp` (**76–80 tok/s**); paired w/ **3,000-tok thinking cap + 5 self-check skills + 2nd audit session** to score **47/89 (52.8%)** on TB2.0. | 🏆 **Reusable IRL Pattern:** Capping thinking tokens + forcing a fresh 2nd-pass audit session eliminates small-model debug loops.
- **Cross-Derivative LoRA & Mac MLX Builds**<br><sub>HF `harness-hub` community</sub> | `Qwen3.8-27B` adapters +<br><sub>`Swift-1.5` · `netprojects` MLX-6bit</sub> | Builders confirmed HF's tiny 304–912 MiB LoRAs transfer cleanly to **`Qwen3.8` derivatives (`Swift-1.5`)** and packaged **MTP-preserving `MLX-6bit`** Mac builds (~65 tok/s 4-bit). | 💡 Test HF harness adapters against your favorite `Qwen3.8` community fine-tunes before training from scratch.

### 2. Community Skill Packs, Harness Extensions & Production Ops
- **`obra/superpowers`**<br><sub>Jesse Vincent · + Hermes port</sub> | `Pi` · `Antigravity` · `Hermes`<br><sub>`OpenCode` · `Claude Code` · `Codex`</sub> | 15 discipline skills enforcing **Brainstorm → Chunked Spec → Red/Green TDD → Fresh Subagent per Task → Systematic Debugging → Verification Before Completion** for 2+ hour autonomous runs. | 🏆 Highest-ROI skill pack for stopping agent drift.<br>⚠️ On Hermes, use `obra-superpowers-hermes` (`hermes-tools.md`), not raw Claude Code tool names.
- **`pi-subagents-community`**<br><sub>`npm:pi-subagents-community`</sub> | `Pi` (`v1.0+`) | Adds Claude Code-style parallel sub-agents, a navigable fleet widget, mid-run steering, & JS orchestration (`agent()`, `parallel()`, `pipeline()`) without bloating `Pi`'s minimal kernel. | ✅ Keeps `Pi` lean while unlocking multi-agent orchestration on demand.
- **`wanbinyu-harness-toolbox`**<br><sub>`dsh-launcher` · `dsh-plugins` · `dsh-theone`</sub> | `DeepSeek Harness` (`dsh`) | Bilingual Cordis plugin catalog w/ SHA-256 verified assets, Windows updater preserving `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh` data, and an experimental LAN Android client. | ⚠️ Independent community repo; check peer compatibility after `dsh` alpha updates.
- **IRL Production Ops Patterns**<br><sub>Hermes & OpenClaw builders</sub> | `Hermes Agent` · `OpenClaw`<br><sub>`Pi Durable` + Obsidian</sub> | • **SRE:** `Hermes Incident Commander` & PR review triage (~30% shorter review cycles).<br>• **Knowledge:** Obsidian + `Defuddle` + `LLM Wiki` memory.<br>• **Research:** Cron 200–500 source digests (6–8 hrs/wk → 30 min edit). | ⚠️ **#1 IRL Failure Mode:** Never jump to 100% autonomy on day 1—graduate from *agent drafts, human approves* to *agent ships, human audits 10–20% weekly*.

### 3. Local Indie Media, Interactive Worlds & Hardware Chains
- **Indie Film & Music Video Studio**<br><sub>`WanGP Showrunner` + `hoodtronik` fork</sub> | `WanGP v20.12` + `Qwen-Image-2.1`<br><sub>+ `MiniMax H3` / `Wan 2.2`</sub> | Multi-shot local stories using recurring location **Sets** (consistent rooms across cuts), per-shot start/end previz guides, cast-card voice checks, & 1-click **Deep Review** lip/continuity audits. | ✅ Runs on 8–16GB GPUs via Extreme Chunker + MMGP v4.<br>⚠️ Community Showrunner forks track specific upstream commits.
- **Walkable Worlds + Sound & Mesh→CAD**<br><sub>Community creators & hardware hackers</sub> | `Hy-Nomas` + `EVOKE` + `LTX-2.5`<br><sub>+ `CADMAGEDDON` (Mesh → CAD)</sub> | Chains `Hy-Nomas` WASD worlds into **`LTX-2.5`** for video-conditioned audio & interactive roleplay; hardware makers use **`CADMAGEDDON`** locally to reverse 3D meshes into editable parametric CAD. | ⚠️ `Hy-Nomas`/`EVOKE` use NVIDIA PixelUMM (**non-commercial previs/pitch use only**).

## Chapter 08 · Frontier Watch (Monitor-Only Apex Radar) [MONITOR-ONLY]
Verdict: This chapter tracks the absolute apex of closed and rack-scale AI strictly to monitor capability ceilings, harness/caching breakthroughs, and open-weight trickle-down signals—never mixing paid or datacenter giants into Ch 01 ($0 Cloud) or Ch 02 (16GB+64GB Local).

### 1. Apex Frontier Radar (Verified Nov 2026)
- **Anthropic**<br><sub>Paid API / Enterprise</sub> | **`Claude Fable 5.2`** & **`Mythos 5.2`**<br><sub>Nov 9, 2026 · + `Opus/Sonnet/Haiku 5.5`</sub> | **1M ctx / 128K out.** `Fable 5.2`: **49.1%** FrontierCode 2.0, **69.9%** FrontierSWE v2, **74.6%** TB-Science, **89.3%** OSWorld 2.1, **74.2%** HLE w/ tools. `Mythos 5.2`: restricted cyber/science sibling (1,000-agent Lean proofs). | 🔭 Sets the bar for **10–12 hr autonomous audits** and strict self-calibration (refusing unmeasured guesses); note tighter bio/cyber safeguard refusals on `Fable 5.2`.
- **OpenAI**<br><sub>Paid API / Codex / Bedrock</sub> | **`GPT-6.2 Astra`** & **`GPT-6.2 Sol`**<br><sub>Nov 17, 2026 · + `GPT-6 Luna` workhorse</sub> | `Astra` leads complex coding/science/computer-use (+ Ultrafast mode); `Sol` catches ~2× real code review issues vs `6.1 Sol`. **API Caching Leap:** switch reasoning effort & toggle tools mid-chat **without breaking prompt cache**. | 🔭 **Harness Pattern to Steal:** Cache-preserving effort/tool switching & explicit prefix breakpoints are exact features to track for local `vLLM`/`llama.cpp` + `Pi`.
- **Google DeepMind**<br><sub>Gemini App Pro/Ultra / API</sub> | **`Gemini 4 Carbon`** & **`4 Argon`**<br><sub>+ `Gemini 4 Neon` (Desktop/Copilot)</sub> | Leads autonomous workflow execution (**53.9%** AutomationBench for `4 Carbon` vs `Fable 5.2` 51.4%), powering multi-step **Task mode (`Gemini Spark`)** on Pro/Ultra plans. | ⬇️ **Trickle-Down Live Now:** **`Gemini 4 Hydrogen`** (Everyday & Thinking) already brought Gemini 4 speed down into `Ch 01` Free Tier.
- **Alibaba & DeepSeek**<br><sub>Rack-Scale & Open-Weight Apex</sub> | **`Qwen4-Max` (2.4T)** *(Nov 16)*<br>**`DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash` (552B)** *(V4.1-Pro pending)* | `Qwen4-Max`: **2.4T params**, 1M ctx, 262K CoT, `$0.075/M` cache hit. `DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash`: asymmetric Causal Encoder–Decoder (**8B active in / 16B out**, **1/4 HBM KV cache**). | 🔥 **#1 Local Watchlist:** Alibaba confirmed **smaller open-weight Qwen4 models are coming**—prime candidates to supersede `Qwen3.8-27B` in `Ch 02`.
